Container.Name: tv-calibration
Container.Overview:
Automated TV display calibration server with guided workflow, LLM-powered analysis, and ZRO CSV auto-import via Samba.
**Setup on Unraid:** 1. Set your ZRO measurement share path in the "ZRO Drops Share" field (e.g. /mnt/user/downloads/zro-drops) 2. Configure LiteLLM endpoint and model in the AI Assistant section of the app UI 3. Map your Windows ZRO export share to the Samba container at `\\<UNRAID_IP>\zro-drops` 4. Open http://<UNRAID_IP>:8000 in your browser
**Services included:** - calcore-server (FastAPI) on port 8000 - Samba on ports 139/445 exposing zro-drops/ share
**Optional:** - Set OPENROUTER_API_KEY in the Extra Parameters field for cloud LLM routing - Set LITELLM_ENDPOINT to configure the AI Assistant endpoint

Config.Name: App port
Config.Description: Port for the FastAPI web UI

Config.Name: ZRO Drops Share
Config.Description: Host path for ZRO CSV auto-import. Map your ColourSpace export folder here. The Samba sidecar exposes this as \\\\<UNRAID_IP>\\zro-drops

Config.Name: Dogegen path
Config.Description: Optional: mount path to Dogegen executable for HDR pattern generation
